headline: Digital Marketing Manager | Performance Marketing & Growth Strategy
summary: Results-driven Digital Marketing Manager with extensive experience in performance marketing, media buying, and growth strategy across MENA and international markets. Proven track record in driving customer acquisition, optimizing ROAS, and managing high-volume paid campaigns on Meta, Google, and TikTok. Skilled in data-driven decision-making, social media strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to scale mobile-first brands. Eager to leverage analytical expertise and creative strategy to enhance app adoption and brand visibility for Halla App.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Developed and executed comprehensive digital marketing strategies for high-growth platforms, driving significant increases in user acquisition, app downloads, and conversion rates.
Managed multi-channel paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok, optimizing for ROAS, CAC, and CPL while maintaining strict budget controls.
Led social media strategy for Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, creating engaging content calendars that boosted organic reach, community engagement, and brand awareness.
Implemented data-driven A/B testing for creatives, landing pages, and audience segments, resulting in a measurable improvement in conversion funnels and lead quality.
Collaborated with creative and product teams to launch promotional campaigns and travel-style offers, ensuring consistent brand positioning and messaging across all digital touchpoints.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Executed targeted growth campaigns across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, successfully increasing user base and platform engagement through localized content strategies.
Managed influencer (KOL) relations and AMA campaigns, leveraging strategic partnerships to drive qualified leads and enhance brand credibility in competitive markets.
Monitored key performance indicators including engagement rates, lead quality, and customer acquisition costs, utilizing analytics tools to refine campaign performance in real-time.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams including product and customer support to align marketing initiatives with user journey optimization and retention goals.
Analyzed consumer behavior and market trends to adjust digital strategies, ensuring alignment with emerging platform algorithms and audience preferences.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Marketing Manager position at Halla App. With a robust background in performance marketing and growth strategy, I have successfully managed high-stakes campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok, consistently optimizing for ROAS and customer acquisition. My experience in driving app adoption and managing full-funnel KPIs aligns perfectly with Halla App's goal to scale its digital travel brand. I am eager to bring my analytical mindset and creative execution skills to your team in Al Mahalla Al Kubra, contributing directly to increased bookings and user engagement. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my expertise can support Halla App's growth objectives.

screening.q: Do you have experience managing paid advertising campaigns on Meta and Google?
screening.a: Yes, I have extensive experience managing and optimizing paid campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok, focusing on ROAS, CAC, and lead quality.

screening.q: Are you familiar with key marketing metrics such as ROAS, CAC, and CPL?
screening.a: Yes, I regularly monitor and analyze these metrics to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance.

screening.q: Do you have experience in social media strategy and content planning?
screening.a: Yes, I have led social media strategies for multiple platforms, including content calendar management and creative direction to boost engagement.

screening.q: Are you comfortable working on-site in Al Mahalla Al Kubra?
screening.a: Yes, I am available and willing to work on-site in Al Mahalla Al Kubra.

screening.q: Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field?
screening.a: Yes, I hold a Bachelor of Business Administration degree.
